brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress and elevated institutional advisory risk warrant a broad risk reduction. Long signals are weak, with composites clustered near zero; ETH and SOL carry the greatest volatility and expected-shortfall exposure. LTC is especially weak on alpha, liquidity, and direction. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC appear fragile because their zero volatility, expected-shortfall, and liquidity inputs provide little meaningful risk validation. BTC is the strongest relative signal but remains vulnerable to the stressed regime.
